options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the DNS zone. The name must begin with a letter and contain only letters, numbers, and the underscore character.

options.name: nameservers
options.description: Specifies the DNS nameservers to which the system sends NOTIFY messages.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the resource exists. When C(absent), ensures the resource is removed.

options.name: tsig_server_key
options.description: Specifies the TSIG key the system uses to authenticate the back-end DNS authoritative server that sends AXFR zone transfers to the BIG-IP system.
